lines.t: (Verse 1 — Male)
I’ve been runnin’ from the noise inside my chest,
Thought I’d outrun all the storms, but I’m still a mess.
Every shadow on these walls keeps stealin’ sleep from me,
But I’m tired of pretendin’ that I’m where I wanna be.
You’ve been holdin’ up the weight of all your fears,
Tryin’ not to break beneath the things you never hear.
But you don’t have to walk alone through every sleepless night—
Let me sit beside you till the worry fades to light.
You keep sayin’ you’re fine, but I see the truth in your eyes…
And I’m not lettin’ go till the storm inside you quiets.
(Chorus — Both)
Oh, your restless mind—
You don’t have to fight this time.
Let the peace you’ve been seekin’ finally start to rise.
Lay your fears down in the hands of YahuShua tonight.
You’re not lost, you’re not blind—
Just a weary soul tryin’ to find
A place to rest that restless mind.
(Verse 2 — Male)
I’ve been scared to open up and let the healing start,
But every time you speak, it puts a crack into my heart.
Maybe mercy’s been chasin’ me longer than I knew,
And maybe I can find a place that feels like truth.
Take my hand, we’ll breathe until the night is gone,
Let your burdens fall like rain until the break of dawn.
You’re stronger than the chaos tryin’ to tear you apart—
Let love be the anchor holdin’ steady in your heart.
(Chorus — Both)
Oh, your restless mind—
You don’t have to fight this time.
Let the peace you’ve been seekin’ finally start to rise.
Lay your fears down in the hands of YahuShua tonight.
You’re not lost, you’re not blind—
Just a weary soul tryin’ to find
A place to rest that restless mind.
Here in this quiet night…
Let your heart unwind…
